claims: Coachella typically ends around 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday nights.
Coachella typically ends at midnight on Sunday.
Headliners usually begin their sets between 10:00 PM and 11:30 PM.
Headliners usually play until the venue curfew.
Shuttles continue to run for approximately one hour after the final sets conclude.
Coachella's curfew is 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
Coachella's curfew is 12:00 AM on Sunday.
Headliner sets usually conclude near the 1:00 AM/12:00 AM curfew.
Some headliner sets may end shortly before the curfew.
